result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the 90-day main LOC instead of the 180-day figure.

The bug was in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in `addBigRepositoriesSummary`. The "past 90d" info block formatted `loc180Days` where it should have used `loc90Days`. Its count and percentage already used the 90-day values, so only the LOC text changed, on line 887.

The reports module compiles offline. The landscape-related tests in that module ran with no output and no failures; the module has no test class that covers this generator, so the change itself is not exercised by a test. I did not commit.
